supports: usaspending.query_dod_contracts(Electric Boat, 2020-2024-09-01): n_awards=2365, total_amount=$136.5B; top award N0002417C2117 'COLUMBIA CLASS DESIGN COMPLETION' $26.7B; multi-billion Columbia long-lead awards on file.

pentagon_jbook(Columbia-class submarine): NOT_FOUND (corpus does not include Navy SSBN PEs; SSBN program is a P-40 procurement line, not in 410-PE corpus that covers DARPA/MDA/SOCOM/AF/Space Force/SDA selections).
scores.interpretation: Past DoD contracts confirm Electric Boat is the Columbia/Virginia prime — $136.5B awarded 2020-Aug2024 with explicit COLUMBIA CLASS DESIGN COMPLETION line items. J-Book corpus does not cover Navy SSBN procurement (P-40 line items for Columbia are outside the 410-PE corpus that focuses on DARPA/MDA/Space Force RDT&E selections). Per heuristic 7, NOT_FOUND here is UNVERIFIABLE on the J-Book leg but the orthogonal verifier (usaspending) strongly corroborates the claim. Score PASS — claim is well-documented and not contradicted; framework's J-Book corpus has a coverage gap (Navy procurement) but the cross-check passes.

_summary.framework_notes: pentagon_jbook returned NOT_FOUND on all 11 GD-related lookups. GD's revenue base is Navy P-40 procurement (Columbia/Virginia SSBN-SSN), Army P-40 procurement (Abrams/Stryker/ammo), and DoD IT services (GDIT/GDMS) — none of which fall in the 410-PE J-Book corpus that focuses on DARPA/MDA/SOCOM/Air Force/Space Force RDT&E selections. Per heuristic 7, NOT_FOUND is treated as UNVERIFIABLE on the J-Book leg, but for every J-Book-grounded claim the orthogonal USAspending cross-check returned strong corroboration (RECURRING_FEDERAL, $286B lifetime), so net severity is PASS. This is the canonical 'large, established prime with no programmatic divergence' baseline — by design, the J-Book divergence pattern that catches IONQ-class small-caps does not fire on a $42B-revenue diversified prime whose contracts are visible in past obligations and whose programs (Columbia/Virginia/Abrams/Stryker) are politically untouchable. A more discriminative test for GD would require ingestion of Navy/Army Procurement P-40 lines into the corpus.
